description: Works out a restaurant's labor cost from the owner's own payroll figures for one week or month, as the free labor cost calculator on restaurantdoctorai.com does, in one of its three modes: share (labor as a % of net sales, against the range for its type of restaurant, with what the points over are worth), hours (next period's labor budget and the hourly staff hours it pays for once salaries are paid) or line (the cut line: the sales per labor hour below which the first person goes home). Takes net sales, hourly pay and hours worked, plus optional salaries, payroll taxes and benefits, expected sales, a target and more, in any currency; a figure that isn't sent is never counted as 0. Returns the calculator's result, how it was worked out, and a link that opens the calculator with the same figures filled in. The figures aren't stored; only an anonymous daily count of calculator runs is kept.

forecast.description: Net sales expected next period, more than 0: the last 4 weeks' (or 3 months') average, adjusted for events and holidays. Needed for hours; for line, the line is then for these sales.

format.description: The type of restaurant, which sets the labor range and the starting target: quick_service = Quick service (Counter or kiosk, fast turnover); fast_casual = Fast casual (Order at the counter, food brought to the table); full_service = Full service / casual dining (Servers, moderate check); fine_dining = Fine dining (Chef-driven, higher check); bar_lounge = Bar, taproom or lounge (Drinks are about half of sales or more).

hourSales.description: Optional, for line: net sales in the last hour of a shift, for how many hourly staff it pays for.

hourlyWages.description: Last period's gross pay for everyone paid by the hour, from payroll: by the days worked, overtime in, tips out. 0 if all are salaried (share only). Needed in every mode.

hours.description: Hours those staff worked last period, from the time clock: overtime in, salaried managers out. Needed for hours and line.

mode.description: What to work out, as the page's tabs. share: last period's labor cost, % of net sales, against the range (needs sales, hourlyWages). hours: the labor budget for next period's expected sales and the hourly staff hours it pays for (needs forecast, hourlyWages, hours). line: the cut line, the sales per labor hour below which the first person goes home (needs hourlyWages, hours, and sales or forecast).

overtimeHours.description: Optional, for share: how many of the hours worked were overtime.

ownerPay.description: Optional, for share: if the owner works without a salary, what someone doing their hours would cost, payroll taxes in. Shown as a second figure.

payrollCosts.description: Optional: the employer's payroll taxes and benefits on that pay, such as health insurance. Left out, labor reads lower, unless the pay already includes them.

period.description: Whether the figures are a week's or a month's: last period's, all for the same dates, and forecast for the next. Sets how a year is worked out (52 weeks or 12 months).

salaries.description: Optional: salaried pay for the period (a yearly salary ÷ 52, or ÷ 12 for a month).

sales.description: Last period's net sales, in the owner's own currency like every amount here, from the POS: after discounts and comps, before tax and tips, plus any service charge paid out to staff. Needed for share, and for line without forecast.

target.description: Optional, for hours and line: the owner's labor target, % of net sales (1 to 99). Left out: the top of the range, where the page starts.

name: restaurantdoctor_labor_cost

checks.description: Figures that look like a slip, as the page flags them.

basis.description: For forecast, or last period's sales.

anyOf.description: Sales per labor hour; null when salaries alone pass the target.
When no line works: the sales salaries alone need.
The guide the result points to.
An hour of hourly staff, taxes and benefits in.

link.description: Opens the calculator with these figures.

budget.description: The most labor can cost at the target.

anyOf.description: The hourly staff hours that pays for.

salaries.description: With their share of taxes and benefits.

anyOf.description: When salaries alone pass the target: the sales they need.

result.description: The result in the page's words, in its order.

anyOf.description: The money over the range, a period and a year.

pct.description: Pay, salaries, taxes and benefits, % of net sales.

pointValue.description: One point (1% of net sales), a period and a year.

anyOf.description: The % with the owner's unpaid hours.
